patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution photography and video are used as dominant background elements for the hero and key product showcases, with content sections scrolling over them.
A distinctive serif font is used for the brand logo, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for navigation, body text, and product labels, often presented in uppercase for navigation elements.

A sophisticated and minimalist palette of deep blacks, whites, and light grays provides a neutral and elegant canvas, allowing the rich, vibrant colors of the luxury products to serve as the primary visual accents.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down. The hero section features a background video that remains fixed in position while subsequent content sections scroll up and overlay it, creating a layered depth effect.

Product showcases alternate between immersive full-width imagery with minimal text overlays and structured multi-column grids, consistently prioritizing large-scale visual presentation of the products.

technique_notes: Implement a full-width video hero that plays on loop, set to a fixed background position so that subsequent content sections scroll up and over it, creating a dynamic layered effect.
Create a sticky header navigation that maintains its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, ensuring the brand logo and primary navigation links are always accessible.

Design product display sections using a flexible grid system for multiple items, and full-width image sections for single product highlights, with text labels positioned clearly over the imagery for context.

design_tokens.type_scale: The brand logo uses a distinctive serif display font, while headings and body text use a clean sans-serif. Navigation links are small and uppercase, providing a subtle contrast to larger, more prominent product titles.
design_tokens.radius: subtle, primarily on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, maintaining a clean and sophisticated aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and full-width product showcases, transitioning to a more balanced density within product grids and the footer.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated use of high-quality, full-bleed photography and video, which serve as immersive backgrounds for content. This creates a luxurious, editorial feel that prioritizes visual storytelling over dense information, effectively conveying the brand's high-end status.
